data.title: 焰影苇草 · 展柜说明牌
data.description: 她在展柜前读完说明，又回头确认标本的名字，认真记在随身的小本子里。
data.camera: 中景，展柜和说明牌同框
data.promptProse: Inside a tranquil museum gallery, Reed stands thoughtfully before an illuminated glass vitrine housing antique Victorian bronze relics. Holding a small leather notebook and fountain pen, she studies the historical inscription card with focused, gentle eyes beneath focused ceiling spotlights.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the glass case, she jots down a brief note in her booklet before gazing once more at the ancient artifact.
